contraindications: Does not apply when the working tree predates nothing: if no predecessor changed the architecture, ordinary recovery already answers.
Classification is not license to weaken a gate. A test that still encodes a live invariant is migrated, not deleted.

discriminating_probe.action: preserve the dirty tree as its own branch, then classify each hunk against current main as TASK_OWNED, SUPERSEDED_CAPABILITY_WIP or SHARED_REQUIRED_ADAPTATION before reapplying anything
discriminating_probe.observable: each hunk is attributed to a current authority, or is shown to have no current authority left

evidence.description: Classification of the 233 recovered files and the merged outcome of PR #701.

guidance.text: Preserved WIP is evidence, not a patch queue. Give it a durable branch first so nothing forces a choice between losing it and replaying it, then classify it hunk by hunk against the architecture that exists now. Work whose justification a predecessor removed is deleted, not merged; only work that still has a current authority is re-materialized. Test history is part of the same classification: a test that only encodes the superseded surface does not prove the capability is still in scope.

observed_result.text: The preserved tree became branch tl-preintegration-ta-tm-57e7c59 at commit f7a7aa7. Classification kept only the current-metadata migration, which was re-materialized over current main from the preserved rename maps; every reconstruction capability was dropped. The result merged as PR #701 at 092ec19 with 735 renamed identities, zero dangling references, zero duplicate canonical identities, and the historical archive byte-identical at 13/13 projections.

problem.text: TL (#681) was interrupted holding 233 dirty files written before TA/#697 materialized historical projections and TM/#698 removed the universal pinker-change obligation. Re-applying that working tree would have reintroduced a rename-map reconstruction recipe, nav_projection reconstruction modules, historical reconstruction tests and universal-ledger assumptions that the predecessors had already made obsolete. Discarding the working tree instead would have lost the only copy of the migration itself.

conditions: a Task is interrupted and resumed after other Tasks changed the architecture it depended on
the recovered working tree is large and mixes still-valid work with work the predecessors superseded

title: WIP preserved from before an architectural predecessor is classified against the new architecture, never replayed
